speaker: Doctor
text:
The clinical picture of migratory arthritis, fever, and the specific description of lesions in a patient from an endemic area like Minnesota is highly indicative of Lyme disease, even with negative initial serology which can occur in early localized or early disseminated stages. The "violaceous vesiculopustular" description may be a misinterpretation of erythema migrans or associated inflammatory changes, but the epidemiology and joint symptoms are classic for Borrelia burgdorferi infection.
